name: How much does it cost to refresh a bathroom in a foreclosed property?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to refresh a bathroom in a foreclosed property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of refreshing a bathroom in a foreclosed property varies widely depending on the scope of work, materials chosen, and the existing condition. Minor updates like painting, new fixtures, and a vanity can range from a few thousand dollars. More extensive refreshes involving new flooring, tiling, and a bathtub reglaze could be higher. We provide detailed estimates after assessing the property and discussing your goals in areas like Pacifica or Daly City.
